specs_json.compute: 3x onboard PCs: i5-1235U motion control + dual i7-1255U/1265U development units

notes: The Unitree H1-2 is a full-size (~1.78 m, ~70 kg) research humanoid upgrading the H1 with 7-DOF arms and 6-DOF legs for 27 total DOF, driven by Unitree M107 joint motors delivering up to 360 N·m. It uses a dual 15 Ah (864 Wh) quick-swap battery system and triple Intel onboard computers, targeting locomotion and manipulation research at roughly $119k.

failure_modes.name: M107 joint motor winding overheating
failure_modes.symptoms: Thermal throttling during dynamic walking, torque fade, over-temp fault codes on high-load joints
failure_modes.mitigation: Limit sustained high-speed locomotion, monitor per-joint temps via SDK, allow cool-down cycles

failure_modes.name: Ankle roll actuator fatigue
failure_modes.symptoms: Lateral balance oscillation, increased ZMP error, clicking at ankle under load
failure_modes.mitigation: Recalibrate ankle joints regularly, inspect linkage bolts after falls, restrict aggressive lateral maneuvers

failure_modes.name: Dual-battery contactor/imbalance fault
failure_modes.symptoms: Asymmetric pack discharge, unexpected shutdown at ~30% indicated charge
failure_modes.mitigation: Swap packs as matched pairs, balance-charge both packs together, replace mismatched pairs

failure_modes.name: 7-DOF arm wrist actuator backlash
failure_modes.symptoms: End-effector position drift, teleoperation imprecision, encoder residual growth
failure_modes.mitigation: Cap wrist payload/moment, run joint backlash check monthly, replace wrist module when out of spec

failure_modes.name: Fall-induced torso structural/harness damage
failure_modes.symptoms: Post-fall joint communication timeouts, multiple-joint dropout, frame cracks near waist joint
failure_modes.mitigation: Use overhead gantry during controller development, full harness and frame inspection after any fall

failure_modes.name: MID-360 lidar SLAM drift from mount loosening
failure_modes.symptoms: Localization drift, map doubling, degraded obstacle detection
failure_modes.mitigation: Torque-check head mount after transport, re-run extrinsic calibration after impacts
